name: @openverify/docs-tools
description: The document generators, record tests and release check of Phase 11 (Workflow 11E, C273-C284): each area renders its committed pages from the repository's own facts, and a test fails when a committed page differs from a fresh render. Private, never published.

scripts.docs:catalog: node --experimental-transform-types --no-warnings --conditions=@openverify/source --import ./scripts/register-ts.mjs src/cli.ts routes && node --experimental-transform-types --no-warnings --conditions=@openverify/source --import ./scripts/register-ts.mjs src/cli.ts render catalog
scripts.docs:all: node --experimental-transform-types --no-warnings --conditions=@openverify/source --import ./scripts/register-ts.mjs src/cli.ts routes && node --experimental-transform-types --no-warnings --conditions=@openverify/source --import ./scripts/register-ts.mjs src/cli.ts render all
